artigo.titulo: Brown spots on houseplant leaves: why?

legenda: A brown spot is a scar: whatever caused it may already be over. Where the brown sits tells you whether it was sun, water, dry air or cold.

beats.texto: Relax! Where the brown sits tells the story.
Big dry patches on the window side?! Too much sun.
Soft brown in the middle, soil always damp?! Too much water.
Crisp tips and edges?! Dry air, or thirst.
Next to a cold window or door?! It got a chill.
So check the soil first, and water only when it's dry.
Every plant is different. There's an app that tells you when.
Comment APP and I'll send you the link!
